Treat modernization as a commercial trigger; renegotiate scope, service levels, exit rights, and run-cost accountability before the vendor benefits from ambiguity. The evidence must survive review by finance, clinical, security, and data-governance owners. Trigger: Applies when delivery lead is trying to combine migration, product build, and operating model change in one gate and the population health data product is part of a healthcare modernization wave with attribution logic and value-based care metric governance. Decision owner: CDAO and CPO jointly. Healthcare context: population health data product; executive counterpart: Chief Population Health Officer; control concern: attribution logic and value-based care metric governance; value path: risk-contract performance and care-gap closure.
